root_cause: The original footer PR became unmergeable after main advanced. Reapplying only the required deltas on current main exposed two additional delivery gates: relative internal linking for /pakketadvies and a section-bounded product rewrite to preserve the real H1 during build-time transformations.
prevention_rule: When a website PR becomes stale or conflicted, rebuild the smallest delta on current main, preserve existing production-authority changes, use relative internal links for SEO-owned routes, and keep build-time section rewrites bounded to one section.

evidence.expected: footer legal/status links remain in the production build while /pakketadvies is internally linked and the product H1 is preserved
